item.description:

Jonathan Rinderknecht, 30, a former Uber driver with dual U.S.-French citizenship, had been charged with two federal arson counts — including destruction of property by means of fire — in U.S. District Court . He was retried on a scaled-down grand jury indictment after his initial three-week trial ended in a hung jury in June.
